statementList.name: 项目资金汇总查询
statementList.description: 关联项目主表与付款主表，汇总项目累计付款金额
statementList.statement: SELECT p.project_no, p.project_name, p.total_budget, SUM(v.payment_amount) AS paid, SUM(v.payment_amount) AS approved FROM 项目主表 p LEFT JOIN 付款主表 v ON p.project_no = v.project_no GROUP BY p.project_no
statementList.sql: SELECT p.project_no, p.project_name, p.total_budget, SUM(v.payment_amount) AS paid, SUM(v.payment_amount) AS approved FROM 项目主表 p LEFT JOIN 付款主表 v ON p.project_no = v.project_no GROUP BY p.project_no
